1: Allah anjeer aur us ki ugne ki jagah ki qasam khata hai, aur zaitoon aur us ki ugne ki jagah ki, yani Filisteen ki sarzameen, jahan Isa (alaihis salaam) Rasool bana kar bheje gaye.
2: Aur woh Toor-e-Seena ki qasam khata hai, jis ke qareeb Allah ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) se sargoshi mein kalaam kiya.
3: Aur woh Makkah ki qasam khata hai, us mohtaram shehar ki jo apne andar daakhil hone wale ko panaah deta hai, aur jis mein Muhammad ﷺ Rasool bana kar bheje gaye.
4: Beshak maine insan ko behtareen tawazun aur behtareen soorat mein paida kiya.
5: Phir main usey duniya mein burhape aur bachchon jaisi haalat ki taraf lauta deta hoon, pas woh apne jism se poora faida nahin utha sakta, jab woh apni fitrat bigaar leta hai aur jahannum ki taraf jata hai.
6: Siwaye un logon ke jo Allah par iman rakhte hain aur neik aamaal karte hain, kyunke woh, burhape ke bawajood, hamesha rehne wala ajr payenge, yani jannat, kyunke unhon ne apni fitrat paak rakhi.
7: Pas aey insan, kis cheez ne tujhe badle ke din ka inkaar karne par aamada kiya, us ke baad ke tu us ki qudrat ki bahut si nishaniyan dekh chuka?
8: Kya Allah tamam faisla karne walon mein sab se zyada adl aur insaaf karne wala nahin, ke us ne badle ke liye qayamat ka din muqarrar kiya? Kya yeh baat samajh mein aati hai ke Allah apne bandon ko be-maqsad chhor de, un ke darmiyan faisla na kare, aur bhalai karne wale ko us ki bhalai ka aur buraai karne wale ko us ki buraai ka badla na de?
